slice: linkado.app sitemap mining, sitemap group indices 1500-1899 (sitemap order = lastmod desc)

notes.verification: curl to chat.whatsapp.com, max 3 parallel, HTTP 200 + non-empty og:title = live; empty og:title retried once (2 attempts total) then dead; 0 transport failures
caveats: Nov 8 did NOT mine the newest 1500 IDs contiguously (team01 sampled ~49 pages across the sitemap; team24 mined 223 homepage/category links), so indices 0-1499 were NOT fully covered by this team; this run mined exactly 1500-1899 per the assignment.
Live rate only 25% (73/288) - these are older groups (lastmod Jul 2026 and older); most invites expired.
Slice is heavily shopping/offers groups (44/55 Buy Sell); linkado Dinheiro category is dominated by money pitches, 18 of 73 live were dropped as scams/fraud/adult.
Descriptions kept in original Portuguese from linkado meta descriptions (1-2 sentences); names are the real WhatsApp og:title group names.
One candidate country AO (Barão do Zap, Angola flag in name); rest BR.
WhatsApp checks ran ~6-7s each under wave-wide concurrent load; verification of 288 codes took ~35 min.
